name: io.github.cyanheads/attack-surface-mcp-server
description: Passive external attack-surface mapping: CT subdomains, DNS, TLS, HTTP posture, RDAP/WHOIS, Shodan.

environmentVariables.name: SHODAN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Shodan API key. Enables attacksurface_lookup_host; absent → that one tool returns source_unavailable and the rest of the server works.

environmentVariables.name: CERTSPOTTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Certspotter API key. Raises CT-fallback rate limits; absent → free unauthenticated tier.

environmentVariables.name: ATTACKSURFACE_DEFAULT_RESOLVERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated default DNS resolver IPs for attacksurface_resolve_dns.

environmentVariables.name: ATTACKSURFACE_HTTP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Default User-Agent for attacksurface_probe_http (overridable per call).

environmentVariables.name: ATTACKSURFACE_MAX_SUBDOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Cap on subdomains resolved during a map_domain run.

environmentVariables.name: ATTACKSURFACE_RDAP_BOOTSTRAP_URL
environmentVariables.description: RDAP bootstrap base URL; override for a private/mirrored RDAP.

environmentVariables.name: ATTACKSURFACE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS
environmentVariables.description: Set true to disable the SSRF guard for internal-network assessment (local/trusted deployments only).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
